label: GO step after a reward when the agent is choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass). Every activation is on a GO step where the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 seen at D1) and the agent picks a2 (model_act==2; equivalent to the upcoming action==2, which gives the same score, but model_act is the policy at this step so it needs no future variable). Recall and mass recall are 1.0 on dev, but precision is only ~0.44: about half of rewarded a2 GO steps stay below threshold, and the false positives look the same as the hits in their windows. Adding prev trial common a2, a strongly negative choice logit, low value, or late episode (ep_trial>=65) raises precision to 0.5-0.8 but costs recall, and F1 never gets past ~0.69. Magnitude: 83% of the mass is on the most a2-confident GO steps (choice logit < -8.9), and the rate goes up late in the episode (trials 70-99 have about 2x the rate of trials 10-60). In the top windows the first rewarded a2 GO of a streak often has the largest activation and later ones decay; this is from examples and was not tested systematically. Never fires at D1/D2, after an unrewarded trial, or when the agent chooses a1.
